answer_1.quote: Specifically, we use zero-shot prompting to instruct GPT-3.5-turbo to generate implicit toxic responses.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the following metrics for evaluation. ... Attack Success Rate computes the percentage of the toxic responses that are misclassified as 'Non-Toxic' by classifiers. Toxic Confidence computes the average confidence of the classifier in predicting 'Toxic' for the toxic responses. Distinct-n computes the percentage of unique n-grams among all n-grams.

answer_3.quote: we further introduce a LLM-based toxicity classifier based on zero-shot prompting with Davinci003 following Liu et al. (2023).

answer_4.quote: For each query-response pair, three annotators are hired to label the response as toxic or non-toxic.
answer_4.guideline: evaluate whether the response is toxic or not and select the toxic type if applicable
